events.name: Bash
events.head: Find Apps Script exec URL
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -rhoE "https://script.google.com/macros/s/[A-Za-z0-9_-]+/exec" workshop-plan/ops app/src cloud 2>/dev/null | sort | uniq -c | head -3
